A '''synthetic leather surcoat''', or '''synthleather surcoat''', was a type of outer garment made of [[Synthleather/Legends|synthleather]] worn by some members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] era. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] wore a [[Color/Legends|tan]] synthetic [[Leather/Legends|leather]] surcoat; [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] wore a black one.
